name: cylinder_20mm_press_slide
parameter_origin: Illustrative synthetic values; a rigid reference geometry, not a named commercial material.
model_notes: At 4 N the band under a 20 mm cylinder is a few millimetres wide, so the same load produces a far higher peak pressure and a much sharper curvature signature than the 100 mm case.

The patch is capped at the setup's 60 degree wrap, 8.7 mm either side of the axis. Beyond that the surface stands 5 mm above first touch, further than the contact pinball, so the truncation removes only facets that could never touch.
Reference geometry and interface for controlled comparisons; it is not a specific metal or plastic.
